Cohort Matrix Class

Source: R/CohortMat.R
CohortMat.Rd

A torch nn_module holding the cohorts of every site and patch as three aligned tensors – dbh, trees and species – each shaped [sites, patches, cohorts]. It is FINN's initial state: build it from an inventory with makeInitCohorts() or from a cohort table with obs_df, and pass it to fit(), predict.finn_class() or simulateForest() as init_cohort. The three tensors are registered as buffers, so a CohortMat moves between devices with the model and carries no gradient. asDF() converts it back to a cohort table (a data.frame with siteID, patchID, cohortID, species, dbh, trees).

Build the cohort tensors, either from a cohort table (obs_df) or from arrays of dbh, trees and species

Store a plain R copy of the cohort arrays (used by restore())

Rebuild the tensors from the stored R copy when they are no longer valid, as after readRDS() of a saved CohortMat (or of the list resolveSiteIDs() returns) in a new session

Convert the cohort tensors back to a cohort table

Usage

CohortMat(
  obs_df = NULL,
  dbh = NULL,
  trees = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  dims = c(50, 30, 10),
  sp = 10,
  device = "cpu"
)

Arguments

obs_df

A data frame containing columns "siteID", "patchID", "species", "dbh", and "trees". If provided, it will be used to initialize the tensors.

dbh

A tensor or array representing the diameter at breast height. Defaults to self$dbh.

trees

A tensor or array representing the number of trees. Defaults to self$trees.

species

A tensor or array representing the species. Defaults to self$species.

dims

A numeric vector representing the dimensions of the arrays (sites, patches, cohorts). Defaults to self$dims.

sp

An integer representing the number of species. Defaults to self$sp.

device

A character string specifying the device to use ('cpu' or 'cuda'). Defaults to self$device.

Value

A CohortMat, a torch nn_module whose dbh, trees and species buffers hold the cohorts as [sites, patches, cohorts] tensors.

The CohortMat, invisibly.

A data.frame with one row per cohort and the columns siteID, patchID, cohortID, species, dbh and trees.

Fields

dbh

A tensor representing the diameter at breast height for each cohort.

trees

A tensor representing the number of trees in each cohort.

species

A tensor representing the species of each cohort.

dims

A vector representing the dimensions of the arrays (sites, patches, cohorts).

sp

An integer representing the number of species.

dbh_r

A numeric array representing the diameter at breast height in R array format.

trees_r

A numeric array representing the number of trees in R array format.

species_r

An integer array representing the species in R array format.

device_r

A character string specifying the device in R format ('cpu' or 'cuda').

obsDF2arrays

Transforms data.table into array

site_ids

The user siteIDs in the order of the site dimension when the cohorts were built from obs_df (the lookup table from array position to user id); NULL when built from arrays, where the site dimension is 1:N.

See also

makeInitCohorts() to build one from a tree list, obsDF2arrays() and array2obsDF() for the conversion between table and arrays, finn_data for the role of init_cohort

Examples

# from a cohort table: one site, two patches, three cohorts
cohorts <- data.frame(siteID = 1, patchID = c(1, 1, 2), cohortID = c(1, 2, 1),
                      species = c(1, 2, 1), dbh = c(35, 12, 20), trees = c(3, 10, 6))
init <- CohortMat(obs_df = cohorts, sp = 2)
init$dbh$shape   # sites x patches x cohorts
#> [1] 1 2 2
init$trees_r     # the same content as an R array; empty slots hold 0
#> , , 1
#> 
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]    3    6
#> 
#> , , 2
#> 
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]   10    0
#> 
init$asDF()      # and back to a table
#>   siteID patchID cohortID species dbh trees
#> 1      1       1        1       1  35     3
#> 2      1       1        2       2  12    10
#> 3      1       2        1       1  20     6

# from arrays: every patch of two sites starts with one cohort of twenty
# 10-cm trees of species 1
dims <- c(2, 4, 1)
init2 <- CohortMat(dbh = array(10, dims), trees = array(20, dims),
                   species = array(1L, dims), dims = dims, sp = 2)
head(init2$asDF(), 3)
#>   siteID patchID cohortID species dbh trees
#> 1      1       1        1       1  10    20
#> 2      1       2        1       1  10    20
#> 3      1       3        1       1  10    20

# trees of the bundled Oregon FIA data as an initial state (?fia_init_trees)
first3 <- fia_init_trees[fia_init_trees$siteID %in% 1:3, ]
init3 <- makeInitCohorts(first3, Nspecies = max(fia_init_trees$species))
init3$dims
#> [1]  3  4 16
